property_summary: For any caller and any uint _val, calling SetMinSum(_val) on the correct contract always sets MinSum to _val (i.e. call succeeds and MinSum == _val); the mutant inverts the init guard and will revert instead when contract is not initialized, so there exist inputs where MinSum is not updated (call reverts) and thus property fails.
change_summary: Invert the guard so SetMinSum only sets MinSum when already initialized (change if to if(!intitalized)revert()).
